Yoga is all about harmonising the body (5) ______ the mind and breath through means of various breathing exercises, yoga poses (asanas) and meditation.

options: all
much
few
many
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "much"

Explanation:
☛ "Much" is the correct answer because it pairs with "more" (adverb) to indicate an uncountable quantity.
☛ In the sentence "Yoga is much more", "much" intensifies the degree, emphasizing yoga's broader significance.
☛ "All" is incorrect as it implies completeness, whereas the context requires a comparative sense.
☛ "Few" and "many" are used only with countable nouns, which doesn’t apply here.
☛ Grammar Rule: "Much" modifies comparatives (-er/more) for uncountable contexts, making it the apt choice.

The debate that (1)__________ every year following the announcement of the (2)__________ often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism and manipulations. (3)___________ to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and (4)___________by the politicians have all become part of the (5)_____________.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5
options_hi: sport
game
jest
line
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है "game"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ game शब्द का प्रयोग उचित है क्योंकि यह एक metaphorical sense में इस्तेमाल हुआ है, जो पूरे विवाद और प्रक्रिया को एक 'खेल' की तरह दर्शाता है।
☛ Sport गलत है क्योंकि यह specific physical activities को refer करता है, जबकि यहाँ larger manipulation की बात हो रही है।
☛ Jest (मज़ाक) और line (रेखा) contextually irrelevant हैं क्योंकि वे इस situation के seriousness और recurring nature को capture नहीं करते।
☛ "Part of the game" एक common idiom है जो किसी predictable but accepted aspect को describe करता है, जैसे awards में होने वाला controversy।

Grammar Rule:
☛ Idiomatic usage और contextual fit यहाँ key factors हैं। Collocation के अनुसार, "part of the game" एक fixed phrase है जो unavoidable practices को दर्शाता है।
